answer.summary: Architecture test HandledErrorRollbackArchTest fails because the change makes CustomDashboardService#restoreStarterPackDashboards catch an IOException from TenantSettingsService.setSettingIfBlank, which marks the shared transaction rollback-only and causes UnexpectedRollbackException at commit. The two CustomDashboardApiTest failures (restored_dashboards 3 vs 6, defaults_set 1 vs 0) fit the same restore-path behaviour the change touches. This is deterministic, so a re-run will fail the same way. The Jackson parse error at line 1245 is logged but handled and is not the cause.

evidence.quote: Architecture Violation [Priority: MEDIUM] - Rule 'classes should not catch a rollback-marking call outside the reviewed list

CustomDashboardService#restoreStarterPackDashboards -> TenantSettingsService.setSettingIfBlank catches IOException, which marks the shared transaction rollback-only, so the commit then throws UnexpectedRollbackException.
java.lang.AssertionError: JSON path "$.restored_dashboards.length()" expected:<6> but was:<3>
java.lang.AssertionError: JSON path "$.defaults_set.length()" expected:<0> but was:<1>
